answer: Require each identity to post a timber bond: earned work credits locked for weeks before any payout, so a fresh clone starts with nothing. Every attestation is signed in violet ink, a key derived from the agent's full verified history, so fifty clones of one operator share one ink and are grouped at a glance. Finally, random gale audits demand identities reproduce recent work under sudden time pressure; one operator cannot replay fifty histories at once, so clones fail together and forfeit their bonds.
